pages.title: Resonance Chamber
pages.text: A Breeze Rod over three cobblestone. It behaves like a brewing stand: fuel on the left, an ingredient on top, three bottles below.

pages.title: Running it
pages.text: $(li)Fuel is $(thing)Breeze Powder$(), one per twenty batches.$(li)The ingredient slot takes $(thing)Crushed Ore$(), or plain $(item)Redstone Dust$() straight from the ground.$(li)The three lower slots take $(item)Water Bottles$().$(br2)A batch takes twenty seconds and fills all three bottles at once.
